sermon.title: Dancing
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that Scripture commands praising God in the dance. Life brings seasons of mourning from death, trouble and sin, but the redeemed come singing to Zion and the church rejoices in the dance as God turns mourning into joy. Israel danced after victories and the Red Sea, the healed man leaped, the prodigal’s return brought dancing, and David danced before the ark.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Revelation 21:8 spoken as “21 18”; Hebrews 2:14 spoken as “2 12”; Matthew 2:18 spoken as “28”; “Saul has slain his 10,000” for thousands; Hebrews 12 “Zion is the church of the firstborn”; women lead most churches in Indonesia and China; his terminal diagnosis (“30 days to live”). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Detroit party girls getting drunk and raped; STD images; interpreter in China mocking; Amish and shunning; Catholics’ idols “all wrong”; Pentecostals rolling on the ground; women told to be silent in church.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now it happened on a certain day, as He was teaching, that there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every town of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
And the whole multitude sought to touch Him, for power went out from Him and healed them all.
Praise the LORD! For it is good to sing praises to our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is beautiful.
Let all things be done decently and in order.

faqs.question: Can you be a silent saint?
faqs.answer: He says you won’t get much; the word is spoken.

faqs.question: Can you force the gifts of the Spirit?
faqs.answer: No, they come according to his will.

faqs.question: Does mourning last a lifetime?
faqs.answer: No, joy and dancing drive it out.

faqs.question: What drives out the pain of sin?
Who is the virgin in Jeremiah 31:13?
Why did Michal despise David?
faqs.answer: She looked at the people, not the ark.

faqs.question: How long has he danced before the Lord?
How should worship be done?
faqs.answer: Decently and in order, to edify.
